title: Give Us Your Feedback!
message: FightPlanner 4 stable release will be coming out this September, and we want your feedback on the FightPlanner 4 Public Beta! Your answers will help us improve both the current Public Beta and the upcoming stable release. Please fill out the questionnaire here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLScSX45nMCrStCRNeCEIpBxZmVkaUDAAFofbl1K8Aov_osgbZQ/viewform?usp=dialog Thanks for your feedback!
